SDRRM Organization

Mataasnakahoy Senior High School

Student-led, school-wide

Safety is everyone's responsibility.

SDRRM brings learners, teachers, and the community together to reduce risk from fire, earthquake, flood, volcanic activity, and health emergencies. Everything on this page is something you can read, try, and take home.

Prevent

Spot hazards early and spread accurate information.

Prepare

Pack the go bag, know the exits, practice the drill.

Respond

Stay calm, follow instructions, help others get to safety.

The people behind SDRRM

Our adviser, school head, officers, and Disaster Response Team. Every one of them trains so the rest of the school can stay safe.

Project HANDA: pack your go bag

A go bag is what you grab when you have minutes to leave. Tick what you already have, and the page keeps count on this device.

Keep it light enough for you to carry, store it near the exit, and check the contents every few months.

    Project ESCAPE: school evacuation map

    Mataasnakahoy Senior High School has two assembly areas. Find your building on the map, follow the dashed line, and gather at the area shown.

    Goes to Area AGoes to Area BGuard houseStairsTrees and hedges
    Download map

    Evacuation Area A

    Rooms 04 to 06 of the First–Fourth Floor Building (shaded blue): walk through the hallway and out of Gate A. The Canteen also exits through Gate A.

    Evacuation Area B

    Rooms 01 to 03 of the First–Fourth Floor Building (go through the hallway, then the path beside the building), New Building VSR (rooms 03 and 04) and the VSR Building (rooms 01 and 02), shaded orange. Walk out through Gate B.

    • Walk, do not run. Do not go back for belongings.
    • Stay with your class and wait for your teacher to take attendance.
    • Stay in your area until SDRRM or the school head gives the all-clear.
    Mark your own points on the map

    Optional. Choose a marker, then tap the map. You can also upload a different map image.

    Project E-READY

    One poster with everything you need in an emergency. Scan the code on it, learn the steps, and respond with confidence.

    Scan.

    Scan the QR code on the poster for more safety tips.

    Learn.

    Read the hotlines, emergency signals, and before-during-after steps.

    Respond.

    Stay calm, follow your teacher, go to the evacuation area, report right away.

    Download poster

    3D Innovation Exhibit: Volcano

    Batangas communities live near Taal Volcano, so knowing the volcano alert levels matters. Pick a level to see what it means and what to do. Then trigger an eruption in the model.

    Choose an alert levelThe model above will react to the level you pick.

    Earthquake drill, 2nd week

    The schedule below shows when we train. Then practice the three moves yourself, because muscle memory beats panic.

    2nd weekEarthquake drill. Whole-school Drop, Cover, and Hold, followed by an orderly walk to the evacuation area.
    Every weekBasic rescue lecture and training. Short sessions led by SDRRM officers and trainers.
    As announcedSDRRM Basic Training Workshop. Watch the school bulletin and your class adviser for dates.
